parameters.sqlQuery:
-- AAC Phase 1K
-- Create one fresh one-time review link for each pending review entering its final 48 hours.
CREATE TEMP TABLE reminder_candidates AS
SELECT
  ap.article_id, a.doctor_id, a.campaign_id, COALESCE(ap.deadline, a.doctor_review_deadline) AS deadline,
  d.doctor_name, JSON_VALUE(v.content, '$.metadata.h1') AS article_title,
  GENERATE_UUID() AS review_link_id,
  CONCAT(REPLACE(GENERATE_UUID(), '-', ''), REPLACE(GENERATE_UUID(), '-', '')) AS raw_token
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals` ap
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` a ON a.article_id = ap.article_id
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaigns` c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctors` d ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_versions` v
  ON v.article_id = a.article_id AND v.version_number = a.current_version
WHERE ap.approval_type = 'DOCTOR_REVIEW'
  AND ap.status = 'PENDING'
  AND a.status = 'DOCTOR_REVIEW_PENDING'
  AND COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(c), '$.send_doctor_review_reminders') AS BOOL), TRUE)
  AND COALESCE(ap.deadline, a.doctor_review_deadline) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
  AND COALESCE(ap.deadline, a.doctor_review_deadline) <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR)
  AND d.active = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.communications` cm
    WHERE cm.article_id = ap.article_id
      AND cm.communication_type = 'DOCTOR_REVIEW_REMINDER_48H'
      AND cm.status = 'SENT'
  )
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.article_id ORDER BY ap.requested_at DESC) = 1;

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_review_links`
SET status = 'SUPERSEDED'
WHERE article_id IN (SELECT article_id FROM reminder_candidates)
  AND status IN ('READY', 'OPENED');

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_review_links`
(review_link_id, article_id, doctor_id, secure_token_hash, status, created_at, expires_at, first_opened_at, responded_at)
SELECT review_link_id, article_id, doctor_id, TO_HEX(SHA256(raw_token)), 'READY', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), deadline, NULL, NULL
FROM reminder_candidates;

SELECT
  doctor_id, article_id, campaign_id,
  'DOCTOR_REVIEW_REMINDER_48H' AS communication_type,
  CONCAT('Reminder: article review due for ', article_title) AS subject,
  CONCAT('Hello ', doctor_name, ',\n\nThis is a reminder that your review of “', article_title, '” is due by ', FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%B %e at %l:%M %p %Z', deadline, 'America/Chicago'), '. Please use the secure link below to approve the article or request changes. After the deadline, the article may be approved automatically.\n\nThank you,\nApex Dental Partners') AS message_text,
  CONCAT('https://apex-content-interviewer.jdold.workers.dev/review/', raw_token) AS action_url
FROM reminder_candidates;

parameters.content:
## AAC Phase 1K - Doctor Review Reminders

Runs hourly at minute 15 and finds pending doctor reviews entering their final 48 hours. Each article receives at most one successful 48-hour reminder.

The workflow rotates the one-time review link before delivery, stores only its SHA-256 hash, and sends the raw URL directly to the centralized `AAC - 16 - Send Doctor Message` router. No token is stored in the communications log.

Activate workflow 16 first, then connect **Google BigQuery account** here. Keep this workflow inactive until the routing workflow has been tested with a non-patient recipient.
